args.note: t3 P-8 trial 2/5 re-run after 09-15 account re-application; new mock futures account 46c39c54d3bb; operator reported app-key linkage 2026-09-23; runner on detached origin/main worktree

limit_price_tick.rounding_rationale: away from the touch — a resting probe depends on the order NOT filling, so a snap must never move the price toward the touch; P-11's marketable order is the mirror case and snaps further in

amend_price_tick.rounding_rationale: away from the touch — a resting probe depends on the order NOT filling, so a snap must never move the price toward the touch; P-11's marketable order is the mirror case and snaps further in

odno_wire_format.identity_matching: The two surfaces disagree on padding, so matching a submitted order against a query row must canonicalize BOTH sides (strip whitespace, then strip leading zeros). A raw strip-and-compare evaluates '762' == '0000000762' and never matches: artifact P-5-20260731T002112Z reported 1 CENSORED trial and n=0 for exactly that reason while the cleanup cancel of the same ODNO returned rt_cd=0, proving the order existed and the query had returned it.
odno_wire_format.reported_identifiers: Measurements that list ODNOs report canonical keys (leading zeros stripped). The verbatim wire forms are the samples above.
odno_wire_format.scope: One 모의투자 account, one session, mock environment. Recorded as the encoding observed here — not as a general KIS guarantee, and not extrapolated to 실전.

measurements.cleanup_liveness_note: Cleanup consumes the qty>0 liveness predicate with the OPPOSITE polarity to coexistence_ms. Here a missing live row silences an error, so a surface that under-reports liveness is fail-OPEN, and the 2026-08-01 'the bias is the safe one' argument does NOT carry over. That is why this lookup requires rt_cd=0, walks the continuation keys to the end of the book (P-5b measured this same surface at 15 rows/page with continuation), refuses to answer on a truncated or unreadable walk, and is never consulted at all for a throttled cancel.
measurements.amend_consumption_note: A fill produces the SAME observation — an original that is not live and cannot be cancelled — and P-8 does not query the execution surface, so this field states the STRUCTURAL fact only and names no cause. The amend taking the quantity is the leading reading because the order is placed --price-offset-pct away from the touch specifically to avoid filling, but 'unlikely to fill' is not 'did not fill'. To attribute the cause, add the execution inquiry P-11 already calls (_FILL_EVIDENCE_SOURCE).

observations.liveness_source: inquire-ccnl answered rt_cd=0 for the whole book and showed no row with qty>0 for this ODNO — nothing was left to cancel
